svg.text: Status key:
planned / decided
legally completed
ongoing or still open
Dates are as reported in the sources listed in Section 14.
April 2021
Government floats a plan to split PIA into two companies — a "good airline" and a legacy-debt vehicle.
Year ended 31 December 2023
Last full pre-split financial year. Total assets ≈ Rs 161 bn, total liabilities ≈ Rs 825 bn, accumulated losses ≈ Rs 713 bn.
Fuel supply disrupted by unpaid Pakistan State Oil bills; many aircraft grounded for want of spares.
21 March 2024
PIA Holding Company Limited incorporated as a public limited company.
28 March 2024
Scheme of Arrangement filed with SECP under sections 279–282 of the Companies Act, 2017.
Shareholders approve the scheme at an EOGM (reported 99.97% in favour); creditors and the Cabinet also approve.
30 April 2024 — EFFECTIVE DATE
Assets, liabilities and subsidiaries legally vest in the new owners. Core stays with PIACL; non-core moves to PIA HCL.
SECP sanctions the Scheme of Arrangement. Competition Commission clears PIA HCL's acquisition of PIACL.
PIACL's last trading day 24 May; delisted with effect from 25 May. PIA HCL lists on PSX 27 May as PIAHCLA / PIAHCLB.
Through 2025
PIACL's FY2023 audited accounts finally adopted at the 8th AGM on 7 Feb 2025. PIA HCL holds its first AGM 19 Aug 2025.
PIACL reports its first half-year profit in about two decades (H1 2025: Rs 11.5 bn pre-tax, Rs 6.8 bn after tax).
22 December 2025
Open auction: Arif Habib-led consortium wins 75% of PIACL with a Rs 135 bn bid (PIACL valued at Rs 180 bn).
Share Purchase and Subscription Agreement signed; first financial closing completed and management control
transferred to PIA Equity Limited. July 2026: 11 properties worth Rs 14.2 bn handed to the buyer.
Still open
Second closing (residual 25% for Rs 45 bn) due within 12 months · Rs 41.6 bn second equity tranche · Roosevelt Hotel sale.
